//: docs/microkernel/K16.md section 3 (ledger 5942 K16.3, K16.4): where a kernel of personality=user allocates, by file,
each with who pays after the seal. check-kernel-alloc-audit.py fails on a file that allocates and is not here, and on one here that no longer does.

bucket, its worst site's: boot = sized before the seal, refused after; job = the job the call is charged to; pool = the named kernel pool of section 4, no job; frames = the frame allocator itself; none = every site marked NOALLOC, room had elsewhere; nojob = a context with no job: an open finding.
frames = the frame allocator itself, what every other row draws from; nojob = a context with no job, must allocate nothing after the seal: an open finding until it does.

arch/aarch64/gic/gicv3.rs.what: the distributor's and redistributors' windows, mapped once at bring-up

arch/aarch64/gic/gicv3_its.rs.what: the ITS's window and its tables, made at bring-up

arch/aarch64/restricted.rs.what: a task's restricted state, boxed on its first entry, in the call of a job's own task

arch/aarch64/smp.rs.what: processors listed and started at bring-up, as x86-64's are

arch/arm_common/gicv2.rs.what: the distributor's, CPU interface's and V2M's windows, at bring-up

arch/x86_64/apic.rs.what: I/O APIC windows and the mask: quiesce_io_apics' one caller is init at bring-up, line 418, so no panic path reaches it

arch/x86_64/mce.rs.what: one site, marked NOALLOC: a poll list with its room made before

arch/x86_64/restricted.rs.what: a restricted thread's saved state: the thread's job

boot_authority.rs.what: the first processes' descriptions, lists and images

claim.rs.what: the device tree's claims, before the seal

console/input.rs.what: marked NOALLOC: the input ring, sized once

console/output.rs.what: marked NOALLOC: the output queue, sized once

device.rs.what: the registry; domain() and bind_domain are per device at devmgr's call: job, devmgr's

discovery/devmgr.rs.what: devmgr's image VMOs and DEVICES; request, record, note_driver and published are the hybrid's, cut under M6

discovery/pci.rs.what: enumeration; a function's drop gives back

discovery/pci/virtio.rs.what: the kernel's entropy device; vector at bring-up

fallible.rs.what: the wrappers themselves: what they call is the global allocator

iommu.rs.what: pin_with's list: the pinning driver's job

iommu/amdvi.rs.what: unit tables at open (boot); a domain's tables per bind: the pool, charged to devmgr's job

mm.rs.what: the buddy: allocate_frames, _below, _run, user frames (charged), program frames (owner), page tables (the space's owner), the per-processor caches

mm/reserve.rs.what: K12's reservations draw on the buddy

mm/unlinked.rs.what: tables freed after a shootdown: frees

object/bare.rs.what: a first or native process: its job

object/channel.rs.what: endpoints and messages: writer's job or a ticket's

object/interrupt.rs.what: the driver's; register_handler under the IRQ table is sized at boot

object/job.rs.what: a child is its parent's; walk's snapshot is the caller's; new_root_as, new_tree_root are boot

object/mod.rs.what: defer: ORPHANS grows from any close, with a drop in place and then an abandon as its fallback: shared, and fine for no job; to be the objects' own link under retyped. BACKLOG

object/oom.rs.what: machine_answer: a frame to test the machine has none: no job, frees it at once

object/port.rs.what: the port's creator; a registration's room is promised beforehand

object/process.rs.what: the process's job; gather's list is the caller's; process::TABLE must be sized by max_processes (K16.9)

object/quota.rs.what: the slot table's chunks: sized by the description under retyped

sched/mod.rs.what: a task and its stack: the job's; new_idle_task, adopt_boot_task boot; reap_* free; cpu_times the caller's

sched/queue.rs.what: marked NOALLOC: run-queue trees with node room in the task

sched/wait.rs.what: a waiter's entries, in the call; hook's room is the waiter's

sync.rs.what: a sleep lock's parking, made with its owner

syscall/native.rs.what: each call's scratch and new objects: the caller's, or the ticket's through charge_target

syscall/native/region.rs.what: the shared table's handles: the region's

syscall/program.rs.what: first_image's scratch, the kernel's at boot

user/address_wait.rs.what: the waiter's job; grow and shrink of the shared table are a finding: a fixed block under retyped

user/cache.rs.what: register and take_from under a job's cache

user/memory_type.rs.what: a type's frames, held at bring-up of the object: the device's

user/space.rs.what: regions and tables: the space's owner; fork's copies the forker's

vmap.rs.what: kernel stacks and windows: a stack is its task's job, its virtual range the pool's, boot-sized
